description: List all sections of an ingested repo in the suggested teaching order, with covered status and weakness scores. Use this to decide what to teach next (first uncovered section) or what to re-attack in an interview (highest weakness_score). Returns metadata only, never code — keep context small and pull code per-section with get_code_section.

repo.description: Repo id in owner/repo form, as returned by ingest_repo
